title: MatchCompleted
description: Published async contract on room.lifecycle.events (P7). Producer: room-gameplay, via outbox-relay. Consumer: tournament, whose whole saga turns on it — `advancingPlayers` is the room's verdict and the only thing that moves a round forward, so a producer-side change here stalls every bracket rather than degrading one number. Traces to docs/design/04-commands-events.md §4.1 and §3.2.2 (the Room owns the match because every game of it is the same people in the same room). The sample is generated by the producer's own test, not written by hand.

advancingPlayers.description: Empty is a real answer: a room nobody was left in advances nobody, and the round still closes.
